title: F11 — Floor plans and pins
tagline: import PDF or image plans, view them tiled, pin each issue at one 0…1 point.

series.name: SiteLog: an iOS app and its API, built

intro: Sprint S6 · 21h · skeleton guide — full code is added when this feature starts.
Code in this guide is a teaching example. Check current source and follow F00 localization rules before applying it.

blocks.html:
• Goal: import PDF or image plans, view them tiled, pin each issue at one 0…1 point.
  • Demo — offline: import a real PDF plan, long-press to pin issues; pins survive relaunch.
  • Demo — signed in: the sheet and its pins appear on the second device; the plan file uploads through F06.
  • Spec: 11 Floor plans and pins
  • Starts from: F08 (issues carry planSheetId, pinX, pinY) and the skeleton Presentation/Plans/.
  • Steps: How every feature runs.
  • File tags: New create the file · Edit change only the part shown · Replace overwrite the whole file.
